messages:
alex_infra: Heads up — starting ~03:20 UTC we saw repeat thermal "ripple" on eu-west1-rack3 GPUs that lines up with short power-limit toggles and a few Xid 13 / ECC warnings. Topology: 4x A100s per node, affected node = rack3-node-17. Not a full thermal trip but enough to evict processes.

maya_sre: I see the same on traces — temp delta ~12C oscillation every ~45s, GPU power draw dips ~80W during troughs. Latency spikes on inference tails. Charts: per-gpu temp + power shows step changes. :eyes:

devon_hw: dump from nvml around the event: 

```
GPU 0: Temp: 86C -> 73C -> 86C (cycle)
Power cap reported: 240W -> 160W -> 240W
Xid 13: Engine lockup, reset issued
ECC errors: single-bit spikes on L2 (count +3 in 10m)
Fan PWM: reported 72% steady
```

zara_ops: cluster-bot posted a node eviction earlier, here's the alert: "cluster-bot: node rack3-node-17 GPU0 process oom_kill evicted due to sudden context loss (Xid 13)"

alex_infra: Interesting that PWM stays ~72% while temps swing — suggests local sensor hysteresis or PMIC power path flapping rather than fan failure. Could be PSU rail sag causing VRM throttles and the driver forcing power limit.

devon_hw: Agreed. I want to rule out cooling. Can someone run `ssh rack3-node-17` and tail `dmesg` + `sudo nvidia-smi -q -d TEMPERATURE,POWER,PERF` during the next cycle? I'll also pull BMC logs.

maya_sre: I'll run a short synthetic load (tiny looped workload) on GPU1/2 to reproduce safely and capture NVML telemetry to cloudwatch. Scheduling now, will annotate events.

cluster-bot: scheduled job id 9872: telemetry-capture (rack3-node-17) starting in 30s

alex_infra: Quick triage checklist:
- Drain node from scheduler for safety (zara?)
- Run telemetry capture + dmesg + BMC logs (devon/maya)
- If reproduces, power-cycle PSU pair for that rack
- If persists after power-cycle, mark GPU0 for replacement and run burn-in on spare slot before re-coding node back in

zara_ops: Draining rack3-node-17 from prod pools now (evicting low-priority jobs). ETA ~2m. :white_check_mark:

devon_hw: BMC log shows transient 12V rail dip coincident with the earliest event: "12V_RAIL_WARN: sag 0.48ms" and then system logs an nv_reset. Looks like a short PSU ripple. Not a sustained PSU failure yet.

maya_sre: Telemetry capture attached (snippet):
```
03:20:10 GPU0 temp 85.9 power 238W util 97
03:20:54 12V rail warn
03:20:54 GPU0 temp 72.4 power 158W util 2 Xid13 reset
03:21:38 GPU0 temp 86.5 power 240W util 98
```

alex_infra: That aligns — short rail dip triggers driver fallback to reduced perf state then reset. Impact: inference tail latency spikes and occasional OOMs on pinned jobs. Cost of keeping node in is more than replacement + brief capacity loss.

devon_hw: Proposed remediation: pair-level PSU swap for rack3 (hot-swap the flagged supply 2) during maintenance window; in parallel flash PSU firmware to latest if available. If ripple continues post-PSU swap, replace GPU0 (possible midlife VRM/PMIC degradation).

maya_sre: For short-term mitigation, we can pin critical routes away from eu-west1-rack3 and enable autoscale incremental warm capacity in eu-west1-rack4. I'll roll the routing in 10m.

zara_ops: I scheduled PSU swap on the maintenance board: window tonight 02:00 UTC (low traffic). Added a note: "candidate for escalating to hardware replacement if post-swap telemetry shows >1 rail-dip in 24h."

alex_infra: Action owners: devon = collect full BMC + PSU serials + upload to hw ticket, zara = PSU swap scheduling & node drain plan, maya = confirm routing mitigation + telemetry checks. I'll open a triage ticket and tag hw-support.

devon_hw: Uploaded BMC + nvml dumps to ticket HW-4127. PSU serials: PSU-A SN 40K-17-ALPHA, PSU-B SN 40K-17-BETA. Noted minor temp sensor drift on GPU0.

maya_sre: After reroute enabled, 5% decrease in 99.9th latency across affected services. Monitoring for recurrence.

cluster-bot: HW ticket HW-4127 created and linked to this thread

alex_infra: If post-PSU-swap we still see Xid/ECC increases, plan is to pull GPU0 into bench for VRM scope inspection and run 48h burn-in (memtests + heavy sustained perf) before putting spares back in.

zara_ops: marking node as maintenance until we confirm stability. I'll update status when swap is done.

devon_hw: FYI: one-off mitigation we can try before swap is to set a slightly higher fan curve (90%) via `nvidia-smi -pm 1 && nvidia-settings` on that node to see if extra airflow reduces hysteresis events — low risk, can test now while draining.

maya_sre: Tested fan curve bump: temps still show ripple but amplitude down ~2-3C, didn't prevent Xid when rail dips. So confirms power path more likely.

alex_infra: Good data. Let's proceed with PSU swap tonight. I'll follow up with post-swap telemetry summary in this thread. Thanks all. :pray:
